# Arjun Vashisht

> Software Development Engineer in Gurugram, India. 3+ years building production web platforms with React, Python and Django, plus Redux, TypeScript, FastAPI and AWS.

## Key facts
- Current role: Software Development Engineer (Team Lead) at EventGraphia, Aug 2023 – present. Owns the React platform and system architecture.
- Previous: Frontend Developer Intern, GoMechanic, Sep–Dec 2022.

- Location: Gurugram, Haryana, India.
- Open to: Software Development Engineer roles.

## Measured results
- 60% faster page loads after migrating jQuery pages to React.
- 90% shorter deployments with zero downtime (AWS S3 + CloudFront).
- 40% more referral signups from a Refer & Earn program.
- Near-zero infrastructure cost for bulk image downloads (Django batching + React Service Workers).
- 20% more efficient feature development via a custom PostHog dashboard.

## Notable work
- Migrated legacy jQuery pages to React (60% faster).

- Shoppin: cross-platform Android/iOS shopping app from one React codebase (Capacitor.js).
